src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [r[:] for r in grid]

    def colored(v):
        return v not in (0, 5)

    def seg_runs(idx):
        s = []
        cur = []
        for i in idx:
            if cur and i == cur[-1] + 1:
                cur.append(i)
            else:
                if cur:
                    s.append((cur[0], cur[-1]))
                cur = [i]
        if cur:
            s.append((cur[0], cur[-1]))
        return s

    vlines = [(c, r0, r1) for c in range(w)
              for r0, r1 in seg_runs([r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == 5]) if r1 > r0]
    hlines = [(r, c0, c1) for r in range(h)
              for c0, c1 in seg_runs([c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 5]) if c1 > c0]
    # vertical 5-lines: tile adjacent horizontal strip along the line
    for c, r0, r1 in vlines:
        srows = [r for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)
                 if any(colored(grid[r][cc]) for cc in (c - 1, c + 1) if 0 <= cc < w)]
        if not srows:
            continue
        cols = sorted({cc for r in srows for cc in range(w) if colored(grid[r][cc])})
        base, n = srows[0], len(srows)
        for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
            src = srows[0] + (r - base) % n
            for cc in cols:
                out[r][cc] = grid[src][cc]
    # horizontal 5-lines: tile adjacent vertical strip along the line
    for r, c0, c1 in hlines:
        scols = [c for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)
                 if any(colored(grid[rr][c]) for rr in (r - 1, r + 1) if 0 <= rr < h)]
        if not scols:
            continue
        rows = sorted({rr for c in scols for rr in range(h) if colored(grid[rr][c])})
        base, n = scols[0], len(scols)
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            src = scols[0] + (c - base) % n
            for rr in rows:
                out[rr][c] = grid[rr][src]
    return out
'''
